name: London Tech Community

voice.description: Friendly, inclusive and excited about tech. We celebrate builders, learners and community members.
voice.tone: Warm and energetic, like a friend who is genuinely excited to share news with you. Inclusive, never gatekeepy.
voice.audienceDescription: Software developers, tech founders, designers, and anyone building or learning in London's tech scene

profileFacts: London Tech Community runs regular meetups, hackathons and networking events across London.
We welcome everyone: beginners, career changers, students, senior engineers and founders.
Our events are free or low-cost, focused on learning and connection, not recruitment.
Partners include co-working spaces, tech companies and educational institutions across London.
We share opportunities, event recaps and community wins on our LinkedIn page.

topics.title: London Tech Week announces 2026 programme
topics.whyItMatters: The largest tech event in Europe returns with a focus on AI and sustainability, offering opportunities for London's tech community to connect.

facts.text: London Tech Week 2026 will run from 9-13 June with over 300 events across the city.
This year's theme is 'Building Responsibly' with tracks on AI ethics, climate tech and inclusive innovation.

mon.post:
London Tech Week just dropped its 2026 programme.

Over 300 events across the city from 9-13 June, with this year's theme focused on 'Building Responsibly' — AI ethics, climate tech and inclusive innovation.

Whether you're a founder, developer or just tech-curious, this is the week to block out in your calendar. Free community events alongside the headline stages.

Which track are you most interested in?
